question: How can observed active allocation and binding financial pressure be distinguished; which semantics, definitions and original data support this?
decision_use: qualify a mechanism for personal low-frequency research before new performance tests

unit: fund series x security x comparable consecutive report period
semantic_principles: observed relative allocation and constraints are separate axes, unknown separately
text statements are claims, not intent ground truth
reported flows and net holdings do not identify all intraperiod transactions or causal forced selling
historical explanation with later filings cannot become contemporaneous trading input
